Steps.title: Secret Santa Draw in 3 steps
Steps.subtitle: No more stress when trying to organize draws
Steps.step1Desc: To create the group, just choose a name and description. No email or phone required.
Steps.step2Desc: Upon creating the group, you will receive a link. The link should be shared with participants, it can be via WhatsApp.
Steps.step3Desc: Each participant must open the link, click on their name and choose a password to reveal their secret santa.

Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Faq.subtitle: If you can't find the answer to your question, contact us at contato@migosecreto.com.
Faq.q1: How to do secret santa via WhatsApp?
Faq.a1: When creating a group, a link will be generated. Just click the share via WhatsApp button or copy the link and send it.
Faq.q2: Can the organizer see who I got?
Faq.a2: No! Only the person who accesses with the registered password can see who they got.
Faq.q3: I forgot my link password, now what?
Faq.a3: At the moment it's not possible to reset the password, the ideal is to create another draw if it's at the beginning of the game.
Faq.q4: I opened the link for the first time, but it already has a password?
Faq.a4: Someone entered your name. Ask the organizer to recreate the group or contact the participants.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.p1: Your privacy is important to us. It is Simple Secret Santa's policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect on the Simple Secret Santa website, and other sites we own and operate.
Privacy.p2: We only ask for personal information when we truly need it to provide a service to you. We do it by fair and lawful means, with your knowledge and consent. We also let you know why we're collecting it and how it will be used.
Privacy.p3: We only retain collected information for as long as necessary to provide you with your requested service. What data we store, we'll protect within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use or modification.
Privacy.p4: We don't share any personally identifying information publicly or with third-parties, except when required to by law.
Privacy.p5: Our website may link to external sites that are not operated by us. Please be aware that we have no control over the content and practices of these sites, and cannot accept responsibility or liability for their respective privacy policies.
Privacy.p6: You are free to refuse our request for your personal information, with the understanding that we may be unable to provide you with some of your desired services.
Privacy.p7: Your continued use of our website will be regarded as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, feel free to contact us.
Privacy.commitmentDesc: The user undertakes to make proper use of the contents and information that Simple Secret Santa offers on the site, including but not limited to:
Privacy.l1: Not engaging in activities that are illegal or contrary to good faith and public order;
Privacy.l2: Not disseminating propaganda or content of a racist, xenophobic, gambling nature, any type of illegal pornography, advocating terrorism or against human rights;
